summary: A minimal implementation needs repository primitives before it needs a memory service.

items.text: Use memory/index.md as the human-readable entry point and keep each durable assertion in memory/facts/<stable-id>.md.
Give each fact a short metadata header with status, source, recorded date, reviewed date and optional supersedes or related links.
Have retrieval return source_path, source_revision and the selected excerpt with every result.
Run a small validator for missing index entries, broken links, multiple current versions and overdue reviews.
